sayLines.text: 📓 Codex: you've heard of **Long Table**. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 60. I've been watching what you're becoming, little living. Names for your shelf: Long Table, Cornucopia. What they DO — that's still yours to learn."
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Mia speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Mia speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Sanne.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 6 people, 57 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 8 plants — 6 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
⛓️ Mia brings it home: The Red Table bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.

Fresh-cut stems on the southeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
🌾 Haven sends 1,600 kcal of grain to The Red Table's fire — not tribute, the other way around. Someone's grandmother over there will remember who fed her. (Trust +8.)
🏃 A runner from The Red Table comes in muddy and breathless. "Maya is dead, and the fire's got two mouths arguing over it. The Red Table is asking Haven to back a claimant."
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Sanne of The Red Table with 4 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)

The southeast ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Sanne of The Red Table didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 800 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the southeast ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
Riders from The Red Table: something's at THEIR door now. They can't spare anyone — and they wanted Haven to know first.
🌾 Haven sends 1,560 kcal of grain to The Red Table's fire — not tribute, the other way around. Someone's grandmother over there will remember who fed her. (Trust +8.)
🌾 Tribute wagons from The Red Table turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)

The Red Table watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
Word with the traders: The Red Table door is clear again. Whatever had them, let go.
Word from The Red Table: Victor holds the fire now. It resolved without you.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~869 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."

👑 Speakers from Emberhold, Ashford, The Red Table ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not
📓 Codex: National beat staged: lead (4 villages).

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🍲 The shared granary opens: 5,000 kcal for every fire of the realm, no strings. Emberhold, Ashford, The Red Table count it — and remember who fed them first. (Trust +10 with each.)
◈ SYSTEM: "Oh. OH. Do you feel that? That's the whole PLANET leaning in. ...There's a table, little fires. A big one. Far away. And it is LOOKING at you. Give it a season worth judging."
Min-kyung, at the fire, not quite believing it: "Speakers rode in, ate our grain, and called us a realm. A REALM. I keep saying it to hear how it sounds."

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. Not yet. The table is being set for those whose deeds are done, and yours are not done. The ledger still wants: the food-thesis deeds. The climb is not over.

◈ The realm came apart — no polity answers to Haven now, and Haven is a free fire again. National no longer describes this village. The climb starts over.
